entities.name: Gull
entities.description: A woodcutter who pledges to kill wizards after his village is destroyed and leads a crusade against them.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: Gull's sister, a nascent wizard and archdruid who becomes High Wizard of the Domains and later the Maro-Sorcerer.

entities.name: Towser
entities.description: A veteran wizard who destroyed Gull's village, kidnapped Greensleeves, and is stripped of his magic.

entities.name: Dacian
entities.description: A wizard whose duel with Towser destroyed White Ridge, later a leader of the Congress of Wizards.

entities.name: Haakon
entities.description: A wizard captured by the army, later a co-founder of the Congress of Wizards who unleashes a fireball at Lat-Nam.

entities.name: Lily
entities.description: A wizard unaware of her power who joins Gull's council.

entities.name: Kem
entities.description: A follower of Towser who changes sides, remembering Gull saved his life.

entities.name: Rakel
entities.description: A person who takes command of the army and introduces organization.

entities.name: Garth
entities.description: A wizard who reappears and helps the army defeat Dacian; later returns to his vineyard with Rakel.

entities.name: Kwam
entities.description: Greensleeves's lover who brings her to her senses.

entities.name: Sparrow Hawk
entities.description: Gull and Greensleeves's long-lost brother, kidnapped and enchanted by Towser into a war machine and the warlord leading the attack.

entities.name: Karli
entities.description: A desert wizard who raided Gull's convoy and killed a third of his force.

entities.name: Petalia
entities.description: Leader of the Guardians of the Grove, Greensleeves's bodyguard.

entities.name: Gull's army
entities.description: The army of victims of wizards led by Gull and Greensleeves.

entities.name: Congress of Wizards
entities.description: A congress of wizards defeated by the siblings, linked through the Stone Brain.

entities.name: Stone Brain
entities.description: An object that fell near White Ridge and draws wizards, with the ability to give magic to anyone.

entities.name: Whispering Woods
entities.description: A forest where the army settled in Greensleeves's Grove.

entities.name: Lat-Nam
entities.description: An island where the final battle takes place and which Greensleeves heals.

entities.name: White Ridge
entities.description: A village destroyed by the duel of Dacian and Towser.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The greatest enemies of the plane, whose return Greensleeves senses.

entities.name: Battle of Lat-Nam
entities.description: The final battle in which the wizards were defeated.

events.summary: The Stone Brain falls near White Ridge and wizards converge on the village.
events.quote: In 4073 AR , the Stone Brain fell in the woods northwest of White Ridge .

events.summary: Dacian and Towser duel and destroy White Ridge; Gull pledges to kill any wizard he meets.
events.quote: Gull the Woodcutter, one of the survivors, pledged an oath to kill any wizard he met.

events.summary: Towser reveals himself as the cause of the destruction, sends Gull to an island and kidnaps Greensleeves.
events.quote: transporting Gull away to a tropical island and kidnapping Greensleeves

events.summary: Gull is summoned back; Kem changes sides and Greensleeves, revealed as a wizard, summons her allies and uses an earthquake and tsunami against Towser.
events.quote: Greensleeves put her hand in the sea and cast another spell - a tsunami .

events.summary: The desert wizard Karli raids the convoy and kills a third of Gull's force before being driven off.
events.quote: Karli killed a third of Gull's force, but was eventually driven off.

events.summary: Rakel takes command, the army defeats Haakon and Greensleeves planeswalks to Phyrexia; Garth helps defeat Dacian.
events.quote: Greensleeves was successful in planeswalking to Phyrexia, bringing some of her friends with her.

events.summary: Haakon and Dacian recruit defeated wizards to a congress of wizards.
events.quote: Haakon and Dacian began tracking down other wizards defeated by the siblings, recruiting them to a congress of wizards.

events.summary: The army forms Greensleeves's Grove in the Whispering Woods and organizes new units.
events.quote: the army formed a community in the Whispering Woods known as Greensleeves's Grove

events.summary: Over three years the army defeats over a dozen wizards.
events.quote: Over the next three years, the army defeated over a dozen wizards

events.summary: The Congress attacks from three directions with a Keldon warlord; Greensleeves teleports the survivors to Greensleeves' Grove.
events.quote: Greensleeves teleported herself, Gull, and the survivors of their army to their headquarters at Greensleeves' Grove.

events.summary: Gull reveals the warlord is his brother Sparrow Hawk; Haakon's fireball engulfs the brothers and Greensleeves, maddened, becomes a godlike being.
events.quote: Greensleeves became a godlike being and lost herself

events.summary: Kwam brings Greensleeves to her senses and she pours her mana into Lat-Nam, healing it and losing her spark.
events.quote: This outpouring of mana caused Greensleeves to lose her spark.

events.summary: Greensleeves strips Towser of his magic, the other wizards are allowed to keep theirs for good, and she is declared High Wizard of the Domains.
events.quote: Greensleeves, who was declared High Wizard of the Domains by her followers.

events.summary: Hundreds of years later Greensleeves is reborn as the Maro-Sorcerer of the Whispering Woods.
events.quote: Greensleeves was reborn as the Maro-Sorcerer of the Whispering Woods

relations.quote: Gull and his sister Greensleeves briefly joined the company of Towser

relations.note: the wizard who killed his family
relations.quote: Towser, who Gull now realized was the wizard who had killed his family
Greensleeves was brought to her senses by her lover, Kwam
Gull handpicked Petalia, who handpicked five other women to make up Greensleeves's bodyguard
Haakon and Dacian began tracking down other wizards

relations.note: enchanted him into a war machine
relations.quote: who had been kidnapped and enchanted by Towser to be a war machine
